what_it_does: Training large AI models across many computers requires extremely fast networking to move data between machines without creating bottlenecks. ConnectX-8 SuperNIC is a specialized network interface card that accelerates this by handling common collective operations (like summing results from all machines) directly in the network hardware instead of making the CPU do the work. It includes programmable packet processing, advanced congestion control to prevent network traffic jams, and a high-speed switching fabric—all designed to keep latency (delay) extremely low while pushing through as much data as possible per second.
